title: AI Safety Debate Fuels Congressional Clash Amid Other Political Turmoil
description: The Capitol Hill debate over artificial‐intelligence guardrails sparks a heated clash between lawmakers, with one side warning that China could dominate the industry. While that controversy unfolds, a wave of political stories-from a Democratic Senate candidate's controversial ties to outspoken figures, to a Democrat settling a long‐standing debt, and the Justice Department's multi‐state voting‐crime indictments-dominate the news cycle. The mix of tech policy, election integrity, and candidate scrutiny highlights a nation grappling with new threats and old rivalries.
